notes: essai (une livraison sur cinq). Schéma unrecognisable, jamais fait chez nous : 768 k vues et 5,2 % d'enregistrements le 29/09 chez @fathom0g (preuve jusqu'au 29/10). On garde l'accroche, pas leur format (vignettes YouTube) : texte jaune, photos candides, 7 actions concrètes. Comme le playbook le demande, aucun item « delete social media » (voir a_eviter). Le pod 11 refait les posts de @fathom0g dans leur propre format, pour un autre label : il n'y a pas de doublon de format. Accroches écrites : « 7 ways to be unrecognisable in 6 months » (retenue : le gagnant exact, avec 7 items comme notre recette), « How to become unrecognisable by next summer » (écartée : date floue selon le pays), « 7 habits that make you unrecognisable in 6 months » (écartée : « habits » affaiblit la promesse). slides.texte_overlay:
7 ways to be unrecognisable
in 6 months
Train three times a week. Nothing crazy. Three full-body sessions, and add a little weight every week. In six months your shirts fit differently, and people notice before you say a single word.
Fix your sleep first. Same bedtime every night, screens off an hour before. Six months of real sleep changes your face, your skin and your mood more than any product you could ever buy.
Pick one skill and do it every day. Guitar, drawing, a language, cooking. Thirty minutes a day is ninety hours in six months. Enough to go from "I can't" to "wait, you can do that?"
Feed your brain on purpose. Five minutes a day of history, art or science. Six months later you'll catch yourself explaining things you had no idea about in the spring. People notice the change.
slides.texte_sophia: Feed your brain on purpose. A micro-learning app like the Sophia app gives you five minutes a day of history, art or science. Six months later, people notice how much more you know.

slides.texte_overlay: Save a fixed amount every month, even a small one. Automate it on payday so you never see it. In six months you'll have a cushion, and money stress shows on your face more than you think.
Cut one thing that drains you. Junk food after midnight, the friend who only complains, the weekend that's always a hangover. Removing one bad habit changes more than adding three good ones.
Take photos on day one. Front, side, how you dress, how your room looks. Don't post them anywhere. In six months, put them side by side. That moment is the best motivation you'll ever get.
